value.beneficiary_payee_map_extends: CAPITAL-DEMO-BOOK-V1 beneficiary_payee_map (docs/decisions/CAPITAL_DEMO_BOOK.md, ADOPTED); venue and agency stay shadow-only payee labels with zero pinned-line contribution
value.eligible_face: sum of outstanding on settlement obligation lines whose payee maps to the beneficiary, minus open refund face
value.reevaluation: ON_EVERY_OVERLAY_COMMAND_AND_SIM_DAY_TICK using current settlement_source.view; FSM face snapshot stays frozen
value.simulation_note: fixture settlement views are immutable in Capital 6487a99 so a margin call cannot fire there yet; the check is still implemented and evaluated
value.uncured_consequence: ACCELERATION: maturity := cure_deadline; default-eligible after grace

value.mechanics: cash distributed to the beneficiary payee on the bound claim is applied to the advance first; the overlay proposes repay = min(outstanding, distributed_to_beneficiary); before DEFAULTED the operator posts FSM repay, after DEFAULTED the overlay recovery ledger records it
value.token_collateral: NOT_ACCEPTED_V1 (token blueprint TK-12: never sole collateral; any future token margin is additive only after TL-0 and TL-L)

value.cure_after_default: NOT_IN_FSM; late recoveries reduce overlay loss and never reopen the case
value.default_trigger: outstanding_exposure > 0 AND sim_day >= default_eligible_day; FSM default is a human-operator command, never automatic; AI proposes only
value.post_default_recovery_ledger: OVERLAY_RECOVERY_LEDGER; the pinned FSM is terminal after DEFAULTED so recoveries are never FSM repay
value.writeoff_effect: remaining exposure charged to loss reserve then platform P&L memo; FSM note stays NOTED and keeps holding the ceiling per contract; no ticket right is touched

double_pledge_control.external: beneficiary representation and warranty of no external pledge; future cr-02 claim-slice registry
double_pledge_control.internal: FSM ceiling reserved_open <= open_face plus overlay claim-slice uniqueness

value.simulation_grade_label: C1 is a synthetic overlay mark; FSM flags collateral_perfected, external_pledge_complete and priority_bound stay false

value.pg_and_settlement_fees: NOT_CAPITAL_FEES; netted upstream in F01-F03 statements; the fee_bps 500 fixture is a settlement test fixture, not a credit fee

value.cap_check: annualized interest plus all fees plus default interest must be <= all_in_cost_cap_bps_annual for every advance; violation blocks offer
value.tier_selection: from the accepted draw receipt credit.settlement_gate; fixed for the life of the advance

value.ledger: overlay memo accounts SIM_LOSS_PROVISION and SIM_RESERVE_POOL in a SIMULATION_FIXED_V2 candidate chart; projection.py chart V1 is frozen; extension owned by terms-overlay with the fin-ledger-contract candidate
value.pool_target: max(sum of provisions, 100 bps of portfolio outstanding)
value.release: AT_CLOSE provision reversed; AT_WRITEOFF provision consumed

value.product_scope: advance against captured settlement claims (F04); production funding before capture is a separate product (cr-01 scope item 1) and is not priced here
value.settlement_linked_rule: term_days = clamp(expected_settlement_cash_day - draw_day + settlement_slack_days, min_term_days, max_term_days) when an expected settlement cash day is known; otherwise standard_term_days

simulation_clock.advance: explicit overlay command recorded in the overlay journal, never an F04 journal entry

checks_ordered.rule: tier from FSM settlement_gate; T1 requires the bound settlement view to be COMMITTED (FSM section 7.5 gate)
refund_face == 0 or fixture_reclassified; the FSM REFUND_OBLIGATION_OPEN rule enforces it
amount <= floor(eligible_face * advance_rate_bps / 10000) in the overlay AND amount <= open_face - reserved_open in the FSM
amount <= single_advance_cap_krw; beneficiary outstanding + amount <= beneficiary_aggregate_cap_krw; portfolio outstanding + amount <= portfolio_cap_krw
approve by a human operator; two-person rule above two_person_threshold_krw; AI proposes only
simulation records kyc_executed=false; real funds require beneficiary legal-entity KYC/AML, owner f04-real-funds-lift-criteria
